column2: norwaj norɡe ɲe europa dukɔwo dometɔ ɖeka . ele europa ɸe ɰed͡zeɸe lɔɸo . norwaj do liɸo k͡ple finland , russia k͡pak͡ple sweden . eɸe dukɔmenɔlawo ɸe xexlẽme ɖo miliɔn atɔ̃ k͡ple ak͡pe alafa ade k͡ple blaeve vɔ adle k͡ple alafa ene lɔɸo ak͡pe eve k͡ple blaeve vɔ ade . norwaj ɸe duɡã eɲe oslo .

column1: Lithuania (Lietuva) nye Europa dukɔwo dometɔ ɖeka. Eƒe dukɔmenɔlawo ƒe xexlẽme ɖo 3,341,966 lɔƒo. Lithuania ƒe dugã enye Vilnius.
column2: lithuania lietuva ɲe europa dukɔwo dometɔ ɖeka . eɸe dukɔmenɔlawo ɸe xexlẽme ɖo miliɔn etɔ̃ k͡ple ak͡pe alafa etɔ̃ k͡ple blaene vɔ ɖeka k͡ple alafa asieke k͡ple blaade vɔ ade lɔɸo . lithuania ɸe duɡã eɲe vilnius .

column1: Paraguay nye Amerika dukɔwo dometɔ ɖeka. Paraguay ƒe dugã enye Asuncion. Edo liƒo kple Argentina le eƒe dzigbe kple anyieheɣetoɖoƒe gome, Brazil le eƒe ɣedzeƒe kple dzieheɣedzeƒe, eye Bolivia le eƒe anyieheɣetoɖoƒe gome. Ame siwo ade miliɔn 6.1 ye le eme, eye wo dometɔ siwo ade miliɔn 2.3 le fiadu kple du gãtɔ kekeake si nye Asunción, kple metro nuto si ƒo xlãe me.
column2: paraɡuaj ɲe amerika dukɔwo dometɔ ɖeka . paraɡuaj ɸe duɡã eɲe asunt͡sion . edo liɸo k͡ple arɡentina le eɸe d͡ziɡ͡be k͡ple aɲieheɰetoɖoɸe ɡome , blazil le eɸe ɰed͡zeɸe k͡ple d͡zieheɰed͡zeɸe , eje bolivia le eɸe aɲieheɰetoɖoɸe ɡome . ame siwo ade miliɔn ade ɖeka je le eme , eje wo dometɔ siwo ade miliɔn eve etɔ̃ le fiadu k͡ple du ɡãtɔ kekeake si ɲe asunt͡sion , k͡ple metlo nuto si ɸo xlãe me .
